messages:
Alice M: Emergency: embeddings service in eu-west1 seeing sporadic 503s due to kv-cache eviction regression. Need expedited hotfix deploy and signoff. Plan: manual canary -> 5% -> 50% -> 100% over ~15m. Requesting pin for canary image and rollcall. @OnCall please weigh in on SLO risk.
DeployBot: build detected: registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-2026-03-21. Canary job attempted but FAILED to allocate reserved GPUs in eu-west1: InsufficientCapacityError.
Ben K: Capacity shortfall in eu-west1. Options: divert canary to eu-west2 dedicated pool or use shared pool (higher latency). I prefer eu-west2.
Carol S: eu-west2 SGTM. Define rollback criteria: 5xx_rate > 1% over 3m OR P95 latency +200ms => immediate rollback. Add alerts and annotate release notes.
OnCall: Approved expedited window with strict guardrails. If we choose shared pool, expect transient p95 spikes. Limit initial canary to 5% and auto-rollback enabled.
Dave R: I'll pin and start canary. Command: `releasetool pin --service embeddings --image registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-2026-03-21 --region eu-west2 --canary 5% --auto-rollback true`.
Alice M: Need two smoke acks: infra + model tests. Smoke checklist: /health OK, embedding dims correct, no OOM, kv eviction rate reduced.
Ben K: Infra smoke on standby. I'll run GPU and eviction metrics 30s after canary starts.
Carol S: I'll run quick eval set (50 prompts). If >=95% pass, greenlight 50%.
DeployBot: action: canary start cb-1778001234 in eu-west2 at 2026-03-21T14:32Z.
DeployBot: note: previous error was capacity related, artifact validated.
Dave R: Canary kicked: cb-1778001234 -> 5% traffic to eu-west2 dedicated pool.
Ben K: infra smoke: `curl /health` => {"ok":true}. KV eviction metric trending down in first 90s.
Carol S: eval 50 prompts: 49 pass, 1 formatting edge-case fail. Proceed to 50% after 3m watch.
DeployBot: metrics @5%: 5xx_rate=0.12%, P95 +60ms. Within thresholds.
Alice M: Moving to 50%. Draft release note: "Hotfix: kv-cache eviction fix; emergency rollout to eu-west2; auto-rollback if 5xx>1% or P95+200ms."
OnCall: Monitoring active, 10m watch. Page if rollback triggers.
Dave R: 50% steady for 6m, no anomalies. Initiating full ramp.
Ben K: Full ramp started, dedicated pool holding.
DeployBot: deploy complete. Version pinned: registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-2026-03-21 (pinned by Dave R).
Alice M: Great work. Postmortem to follow: root cause cache eviction policy regression + recommendation to improve reserved pool autoscale and earlier spillover policy. :white_check_mark:
Carol S: Adding follow-up action to release notes and tracking ticket for autoscale policy.
DeployBot: closing canary cb-1778001234.
